name: rewst-mcp
description: Operate and monitor Rewst RPA across every client org from the terminal or your AI agent: workflow execution health, failure triage, automation ROI, dormant-workflow cleanup, cross-org config drift, and integration-pack coverage - the multi-tenant answers the web console makes you assemble one org at a time.

rewst_base_url.title: REWST_BASE_URL
rewst_base_url.description: Rewst API base URL for your region. Defaults to the US (https://api.rewst.io); set this for EU/AU or other regional instances.

rewst_api_token.title: REWST_API_TOKEN
rewst_api_token.description: Rewst API token from an API client you create in the Rewst console (sent as a bearer token).

rewst_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
rewst_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

rewst_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
rewst_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

rewst_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
rewst_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the local store is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

rewst_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
rewst_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Rewst requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
